title: Collect pytest-style tests in canonical gates
summary: Discover and run every module-level pytest-style first-party test in required CI and strict release gates, then restore the linked WebView generated-contract evidence those tests expose as stale.
reason: Remediate P2 AUDIT-FIND-W10-002 and its exposed same-spine P2 AUDIT-FIND-W12-006. Current required workflows and the strict release self-test use unittest-only discovery, while 34 current module-level test functions across four files require pytest and remain outside those gates; pytest is absent from declared development dependencies, and executing the newly collected tests proves the tracked WebView public-contract, route, command-boundary, and touchpoint evidence is stale.
behavior_before: Canonical CI and -RequireTests release validation could pass without collecting module-level pytest test functions, and no dependency contract guaranteed that pytest was installed.
behavior_after: A shared AST inventory selects every non-browser test file containing module-level test functions, executes those files with declared pytest, fails closed on discovery or runner errors, and is invoked by both required workflows and the strict release gate. Required Windows jobs capture the pytest process exit code before any later native command can overwrite it, required Linux jobs execute platform-sensitive cases, and all four WebView generated-contract artifacts reproduce from current inputs.
tests_added: Inventory unit tests cover module-level sync/async discovery, exclusion of class methods and browser files, deterministic paths, fail-closed empty/parse-error behavior, current-repository coverage, declared pytest dependency, CI/release wiring, and captured native exit-code propagation.
WebView touchpoint regression coverage proves the Launch priority export scope is local staging while the Queue export button owns POST /api/queue/priority-export.
manual_validation: Inventory --list reported 34 module-level functions across four files; --collect-only collected 36 pytest cases.

Inventory --run passed 35 cases and skipped one Windows symlink-alias case because the host lacks SeCreateSymbolicLink privilege (WinError 1314). The same required inventory command is wired into both Ubuntu CI jobs to execute that platform-sensitive case; no skipped case is claimed as a local pass.
A clean managed temporary virtual environment installed requirements/dev.txt with pytest 9.1.1 and collected all 36 cases; the managed temporary directory was cleaned automatically.

Focused validation passed: 4 inventory tests; 2 CI failure-propagation tests / 5 subtests; 102 browser-inventory and Tauri scaffold tests / 2 subtests; 59 generated-context and audit tests / 15 subtests; 13 WebView command/touchpoint tests.
Direct Invoke-PythonPytestStyleTests -Required passed under the bundled PowerShell 7.6 host after correcting zero-result array handling in the release helper.
All four WebView generated checks passed: public contract, route ownership, command boundary, and touchpoint ledger are current.

npm run webview:prework:check remains blocked by unrelated existing ESLint budget drift: 1,389 warnings versus 1,387, including complexity, max-lines-per-function, unused-variable, and no-undef pair drift.

The final bundled-host strict release self-test reached and passed the new pytest-style Python stage, but the aggregate remained red on unrelated repository-wide failures: five desktop-test failures with one skip, a tooling-suite failure, five stale summaries, stale smoke-wrapper and duplicate-test reports, active-doc DOC005, the known package cycle, Python lint, and current WebView reliability. No aggregate release pass is claimed.
Architecture guardrails passed for 93 creation candidates; risky-file registry validation passed; the god-file guard reported 0 errors and 52 warnings across the current dirty worktree.
Final project-index and feature-map check modes passed; validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage passed with 1,156 valid packets; git diff --check passed with line-ending warnings only.
rollback_plan: Revert the inventory runner, gate invocations, pytest development dependency, tests, inventory documentation, WebView audit classification correction and generated contract artifacts, generated context, and this packet together. Do not retain a declared gate that silently skips module-level tests or a generated baseline that cannot reproduce from current inputs.
notes: Protected invariant: every committed first-party test must be collected by a required CI or strict release gate using a declared runner, and generated WebView architectural evidence must reproduce from current inputs before release claims use it. Required validation: clean dependency install, collect-only count proof, execute the discovered pytest-style suite, workflow contract tests, all WebView generated-contract checks, complete prework where unrelated baselines permit, and strict release self-test. The priority-export method/owner mismatch was reviewed and fixed in MP-CHANGE-2026-0723-013 before baseline regeneration. This changes validation/evidence only and does not execute media or alter runtime media policy, so representative real-media validation is not required.
